description: This is a JUnit test class for MainMethodExceptionHandler, testing its immutability, null handling, logging behavior, and exception rethrowing.

classes.name: MainMethodExceptionHandlerTest
classes.description: Test class for MainMethodExceptionHandler focusing on exception handling, immutability, and logging behavior.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test instance with a mocked logger.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullLogger
methods.description: Tests that obtaining an instance with null logger throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToRunNullRunnable
methods.description: Tests that calling with null Runnable throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: nothingIsLoggedIfRunnableThrowsNoException
methods.description: Verifies that no logging occurs when Runnable completes without exceptions.

methods.name: exceptionIsReThrownAndLoggedAppropriately
methods.description: Verifies that exceptions thrown by Runnable are rethrown and logged.

methods.name: errorIsReThrownAndLoggedAppropriately
methods.description: Verifies that Errors thrown by Runnable are rethrown and logged.
